M18 — 2026-09-22 — supersedes rust-core M11
Writing a record whose truth is on another worktree's branch: rust-core lives in ~/IO/sofar-rust-core, and main's copy of it is stale. Event-only writes (notes, decisions, memories, session events) may go through main; carry them over with `sofar export <slug>` | `sofar import - <slug> --root <worktree>`, which dedupes by id. Better still, append them in the worktree itself: `node packages/engine/dist/cli.js event append <slug> --session <id> --type <type> --payload -`, which also avoids the rebinding in rust-core M17. A plan replacement (plan_updated) must be made on the branch, by spawning `sofar mcp` with that worktree as cwd: from main's stale copy it clobbers the branch plan when the copies union. task_added and task_status_changed need no plan replacement and can be appended in the worktree the same way.
